method: Attempt 1 had only dumped the facts (reg-dump.txt, reg-conf.txt). Attempt 2: duplicate candidates from shared quote sentences and claim-token similarity (reg_analyze.py, reg-analysis.txt; reg_view.py prints pairs); display proposals (reg_propose.py) reviewed by hand; decisions in reg-decisions.json; patches built and checked by reg_build.py (every number-free display is a verbatim phrase of a quote and has at most 8 words); applied through saa.py by reg_apply.py and reg_conflicts.py (log reg-apply.log.jsonl); demand statuses by reg_demand.py with reg-demand-extra.json.
rules_applied: Duplicates: superseded when two facts quote the same sentence of the same page, or one fact is a composite of facts that exist on their own; pricing-lens copies of FAQ answers merged into one fact; FAQ facts that repeat a guide sentence on a different page were kept for the FAQ quick-fire. Kept facts took the bullets, the higher relevance, hard true and the FAQ note of what they absorbed.
Displays without a digit: a verbatim phrase of at most 8 words from one quote (RULINGS 2026-10-11); about 400 long displays were shortened, 8 dropped, 14 added.

Claims cut or grounded: client-vpn-security-group-default-applied-to-association (FAQ sentence moved out; guide sentence on changing security groups added), direct-connect-lag-not-more-resilient-against-device-failure (sentence not in the quote removed), direct-connect-no-setup-charge-no-minimum-term ('no minimum term' reworded to the quote), direct-connect-dxgw-no-direct-traffic-between-attached-vifs (guide sentence added as evidence), client-vpn-change-concurrent-connections-per-client (post sentence added for the display).
Qualifiers: 52 empty scopes filled; 8 Direct Connect quotas that 'cannot be increased' set to default_or_max max.
Namespaces: all facts sit in the namespace of the service they describe (site-to-site-vpn, direct-connect, client-vpn); no fact of these services has another home chapter.
